svg.title: Projected covariance: the right distance depends on the cluster's shape
svg.desc: Simulated two-cluster embedding with differently tilted ellipses. A straight dashed line marks the Euclidean midline between centers; a solid curve marks the covariance-aware boundary. Ringed points would be assigned to the wrong cluster by Euclidean distance but to the correct cluster by the covariance-aware distance.
svg.text: Noise shape decides the nearest center
Ringed: wrong by Euclidean distance, right with Σk.
